Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.statemachine

Class StateMachineBase<StateEnum extends Enum<StateEnum>>

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.lib.NinjasLib.statemachine.StateMachineBase<StateEnum>
Type Parameters:
StateEnum - The enum type enumerating every state this state machine can be in.
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public abstract class StateMachineBase<StateEnum extends Enum<StateEnum>> extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
Generic base class for building a robot state machine as a SubsystemBase. A state machine over StateEnum is a directed graph whose vertices are the enum's constants and whose edges are transition Commands; subclasses build this graph by overriding define() and calling addEdge(StateEnum, StateEnum, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command), addOmniEdge(StateEnum, java.util.function.Supplier<edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command>), addStateEnd(StateEnum, frc.lib.NinjasLib.commands.StateEndCommand, StateEnum) and addStateCommand(StateEnum, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command).

Once built, callers drive the state machine with changeState(StateEnum, boolean, boolean, boolean), changeStateForce(StateEnum) or forceState(StateEnum) for a single transition, or runStatesPath(StateEnum) to automatically hop through several states via the shortest path to a target. periodic() advances the currently-running transition command, fires any configured state-end conditions, starts/stops each state's background command, advances an in-progress path, and logs the state machine's status via NinjasLogger - subclasses must ensure it is called every loop (which happens automatically for a registered SubsystemBase).

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Called periodically. Checks state end conditions and handles transition command completion, then logs state machine data via AdvantageKit.

    • changeState

      public void changeState(StateEnum wantedState)

    • changeStateForce

      public void changeStateForce(StateEnum wantedState)
      Tries to set the state of the robot to the given state even if already transitioning, by the connecting edge between the current (or target) state and the wanted one.
      Parameters:
      wantedState - The state to change the robot state to.

    • forceState

      public void forceState(StateEnum wantedState)
      Immediately sets the robot state to the given state without running a transition command. Cancels any currently running edge command and state end conditions.
      Parameters:
      wantedState - The state to force the robot into.

    • runStatesPath

      public void runStatesPath(StateEnum wantedState)
      Calculates BFS path from current state to wantedState and starts automatically transitioning between states to reach wantedState.
      Starts a transition immediately at call and starts the next transitions each time a transition ends.
      Stops when reached wantedState.
      If there is no path between currentState and wantedState, does nothing,
      Parameters:
      wantedState - The target state of the path

      public boolean isTransitioning()

    • getCurrentEdgeCommand

      public edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command getCurrentEdgeCommand()
      Returns:
      The current edge/transition command. If the robot is transitioning from one state to another, the edge command will be returned. Otherwise, will return null.

    • getCurrentState

      public StateEnum getCurrentState()
      Returns:
      The state machine's current state. While transitioning, this is still the state being transitioned away from until the edge command finishes - see getTargetState() for the destination.

    • getTargetState

      public StateEnum getTargetState()
      Returns:
      The target state the statemachine is currently transitioning to. If an edge command is running, the state the edge is transitioning to will be returned. Otherwise, will return null.

    • printGraph

      public void printGraph()
